title: Silverpine telemetry vendor — private deploy onboarding scratchpad
content:
Meeting notes (11/12/2025)
Participants: Ava (Redwood CS), Diego (Silverpine eng lead), Priya (security), Samir (infra), + sales observer

High-level ask:
- Silverpine collects telemetry from medical devices; must keep PHI on-prem and have audit traces. They want Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) with our control plane in their VPC.
- Target: NRT inference for short summaries and anomaly detection, ~20 qps peak per region, 50ms P95 per request (edge case), typical response size 200-400 tokens.

Constraints / gotchas they emphasized:
- No external egress for raw telemetry payloads. Any metadata sent to hosted services must be hashed/pseudonymized.
- KMS/HSM requirement: customer-managed key for model artifacts and logs. HSM available in their on-prem datacenter (Luna). We need to confirm our Private installer supports customer HSM integration (PKCS#11 path).
- Strict audit retention: immutable logs for 365 days, must export to their SIEM.
- Network: restricted subnet with outbound firewall rules; only allowed to reach Redwood control plane on two IPs/ports — need static IPs for control plane (ask infra).
- Compliance: SOC2 + HIPAA expectations. They will want a BAA. Legal is already in loop (CC: Priya).

Model / runtime preferences:
- They mentioned wanting a decoder model with safety filters. Suggested starting point: opt-in Llama2-13B-ish family (fine-tuned) or a smaller 30B depending on quantization.
- Suggested quant: q4f16 for cost. But they want we preserve accuracy on numeric device outputs -> run evals on numeric extraction tasks before recommending aggressive quant.
- GPU: A100 preferred for peak sustained throughput; discussion of A10G for lower-cost staging. Need to produce perf numbers for both at 200-token context and 1024-token context.

Performance & SLO notes:
- Baseline target: 20 qps peak, 50ms P95 (this is aggressive). Action: show batch vs single inference latency tradeoffs for the two GPUs.
- They plan to use streaming for long-running anomaly summaries to the UI; confirm our streaming hooks + chunking semantics match their frontend.

Integration details / API expectations:
- They want a REST endpoint inside their VPC that maps 1:1 to our inference route. Prefer token-based auth integrated with their Okta via OIDC.
- Function calling: They will want structured outputs (JSON with fields: device_id, timestamp, anomaly_score, summary). Need to validate tokenizer/serialization edge cases for device ids (alphanumeric + punctuation).
- Embeddings: they also want a parallel search index for telemetry vectors. Discussed use of Redwood embeddings route, but embeddings MUST stay on-prem. Confirm local vector store support (we currently recommend Faiss/HNSW).

Security & encryption:
- Must use their KMS for model encryption at rest.
- TLS mutual auth for control plane <-> agent communications is required. Confirm mTLS support in our Private agent installer.

Open questions / blockers:
- Can Redwood Private operate entirely air-gapped (no control plane connectivity) but with periodic out-of-band license check? (Silverpine leaning toward occasional outbound connectivity only). Need eng/infra answer.
- HSM integration: what exact primitives we support (signing, wrapping) and PKCS#11 endpoints.
- Static IPs: do we support pinned control plane egress IPs for customers? Ask infra.
- Audit log export format and connector to their Splunk/QRadar.

Action items (owners & target dates):
- Ava: capture requirements + draft technical checklist for eng private-deploy team (due 2025-11-14).
- Diego: provide sample telemetry payloads (sanitized) and 3 representative queries (due 2025-11-15).
- Priya: upload security questionnaire + initial legal contact for BAA (due 2025-11-14).
- Samir + eng-private-deploy: confirm A100/A10G perf numbers + mTLS/HSM feasibility (due 2025-11-19).
- Infra: confirm whether we can provide static IPs for control plane reachability (ask via ticket INF-2987) (due 2025-11-18).
- Product: prepare recommended canary rollout plan for model/fallbacks (Ava to loop in Product) (due 2025-11-20).

Prompting / eval notes (internal):
- Need a small eval suite with numeric extraction tests and device id fidelity. Create dataset: 500 sanitized device messages with ground truth.
- Quality thresholds: F1 > 0.92 on numeric extraction, anomaly_score rank correlation > 0.85 vs baseline rule engine.

Notes to self (quick):
- Keep docs light; Silverpine responds well to clear checklists.
- Avoid mentioning full product names in send-to-customer slides; use neutral phrasing for on-prem steps.
- Slack channel established: #cs-silverpine (pin PRs and jira).

Next steps for meeting 2 (tentative 11/19):
- Walkthrough of sanitized payloads + live inference demo on A10G staging.
- Show full end-to-end audit log export to Splunk sample.
- Present canary rollout plan and fallback policies.

Misc technical snippets captured during call:
- "If you send >1024 tokens we need to enable prefix KV caching to avoid cold-start blowups" — Samir
- "We cannot accept any PII in logs; md5(hid) + truncation for correlation is acceptable" — Priya
- "Latency target is eventually 50ms P95 but we'd accept 100ms initial with canary" — Diego

Version history (brief):
- 2025-11-12: initial capture after intro call
- 2025-11-14: updated with sample payloads from Diego and security questionnaire link (Priya)
- 2025-11-16: added perf action items and clarified HSM ask
